top_categories.workout_context: 75 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Jedermann-Rennen Rund um Köln's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
51ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Jedermann-Rennen Rund um Köln's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 75 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Jedermann-Rennen Rund um Köln. Train it until it feels boring.
At Jedermann-Rennen Rund um Köln, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Base fitness for Jedermann-Rennen Rund um Köln. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mixed terrain at tempo for 75 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,839ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on mixed terrain. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.heat: May in Cologne, Germany (Rheinauhafen start/finish, through Bergisches Land) can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before Jedermann-Rennen Rund um Köln and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Jedermann-Rennen Rund um Köln’s 75 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 75 miles of mixed terrain in Cologne, Germany (Rheinauhafen start/finish, through Bergisches Land).
